subject: ddl: allow DDL on the system table in BDR mode (#63604)
summary: Diff bypasses BDR DDL restrictions for system schemas via `filter.IsSystemSchema` in `pkg/ddl/job_submitter.go` (all denied actions) plus the primary-role add/modify-column option checks in `pkg/ddl/executor.go` and `pkg/ddl/modify_column.go`; adds bootstrap-upgrade coverage for BDR primary/secondary. Reviewed the DeniedByBDR gating and system-schema detection usage and found no remaining Blocker/High issues in DDL correctness, metadata/state-machine behavior, or concurrency; upstream/master retains the same logic.
